Judah Lewis is an American actor who has gained recognition for his work in film and television. Here is what I know about him:

## Early Life
- Born on November 27, 2001, in the United States
- Showed interest in acting from a young age

## Career Highlights

### Film
- **The Babysitter** (2017) - One of his most notable roles, playing Cole in this Netflix horror-comedy directed by McG. He starred alongside Samara Weaving.
- **The Babysitter: Killer Queen** (2020) - He reprised his role as Cole in this sequel, also on Netflix.
- **Demolition** (2015) - He appeared in this drama alongside Jake Gyllenhaal and Naomi Watts, which gave him early exposure.
- **The Christmas Chronicles** (2018) - He played Teddy Pierce in this popular Netflix holiday film starring Kurt Russell as Santa Claus.
- **The Christmas Chronicles: Part Two** (2020) - He reprised his role in the sequel.

## Notable Characteristics
- He is known for playing coming-of-age roles and teenage characters
- He has built a strong association with Netflix productions
